note: Phase 2 expansion: 292 entries (up from the 133-entry v0.1 seed), extended across people/relationships, time/space, emotions, power/hierarchy, warfare, crafts/materials, everyday life, abstract concepts, and additional nature/descriptive vocabulary (DESIGN_DECISIONS.md D15). Project target per Master Development Specification §6.2 remains 500-1000 entries; this file is meant to keep growing entry by entry under the same schema, validated against data/phonology/phonology.json. | v0.3.0: added 9 closed-class words (7 postpositions, the subordinator 'tesh' = when, and the modal verb 'mar' = must) required by the grammar-coverage work; see each entry's `provenance` and `note`.
